in_marathi.name: Dipan
in_marathi.long_meaning: Dipan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Dipan is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Dip' which means 'luminous' or 'radiant'. In Hindu mythology, the name is associated with Lord Indra, the god of rain, thunder, and lightning. Dipan is also a name of the sun god, Surya. Therefore, the name symbolizes light, brilliance, and wisdom.
